course.description:
Subjects Covered: Geography, Political Science, History, Economics , Maths , Hindi  & English (Hindi  & English in recorded format).

Live Classes with real-time interaction and Live Doubt-Solving Sessions.
Instant Access to Recorded Classes on the NextToppers app after every live session.
PDF Class Notes for every lecture to make your learning easy.
Regular Tests to track your progress and boost your preparation.
Expert Mentorship from Shobhit Sir & Prashant Sir and Digraj Sir.
Course Access available till your final exams (2025-26).
Note: This batch is non-refundable.
